title: Panzer Dragoon
native_title: パンツァー・ドラグーン
overview:
All destiny rests on the wings of the dragon soaring through the heavens... All hope rests in the soul of Panzer Dragoon...

An age of twilight... After thousands of years, the power of the "Ancient Age" awakens once more. Two powers that can never coexist. One leads to a destiny called ruin, the other leads to a destiny called hope. Yes, everything is about to begin. Together with the destiny of Panzer Dragoon's battle...

A young hunter, Keil, witnesses a battle between a blue dragon and the Dark Dragon. The blue dragon's dying rider entrusts him with his mission and his mount: stop the Dark Dragon before it reawakens an ancient ruin and brings havoc to the world.

In this 3D rail shooter you ride the dragon along a set flight path, turning to face enemies coming from any direction with full 360-degree view and a radar. Fire the rider's gun for quick shots, or sweep the cursor across up to eight targets to unleash the dragon's homing laser. Earn bonus credits for high accuracy at the end of each episode.

- 1 player
- Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty settings
- Switchable camera distances

すべての運命は、天駆ける飛龍の翼に…。
すべての希望は、PANZER DRAGOONの魂に…。

黄昏の時代…数千年の時を経て、「旧世紀」の力が再び目覚める。決して相容れることのない2つの力。1つは、滅びという名の運命を導き、1つは、希望という名の運命を導く。そう、すべては今始まろうとしているのだ。PANZER DRAGOONの闘いの運命とともに…。
